title: Coordinate console rollback & acceptance matrix for staged runtime rollout
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a single, actionable acceptance matrix and sign-off workflow for the Console-controlled staged rollout of runtime-1.22. This ticket aligns Engineering (runtime + SRE), Design (Console UX), and Legal (data residency & audit) on concrete acceptance criteria, rollback triggers, and the handoff checklist for production release. The goal is to eliminate ambiguity during canaries and provide a clear fast path for rollback decisions during incidents.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A published acceptance matrix (CSV/markdown) that maps each rollout gate to a responsible approver, required metrics, and threshold values.
A2: Engineering provides an automated dashboard (link included) that surfaces the gates in real time: error-rate, 95th latency, token throughput, and KV-cache miss rate for the canary cohort.
A3: Design delivers the Console UX for 'Gate status' and 'Initiate rollback' flows; flows must include confirmation and reason capture.
A4: Legal confirms the data residency and audit logging checklist for Private customers and signs off on the release notes language.
A5: A documented rollback playbook (runbook) with step-by-step instructions and pre-authorized approvers exists in Confluence and is linked from the Console UI.
A6: All signoffs recorded in the PRD and the Linear ticket with timestamped approvals; no open blockers tagged as high-severity within 48 hours of scheduled rollout.
A7: Post-rollout monitoring plan with specific post-mortem owners and evaluation window (72 hours) is created and assigned.
signoffs_required: Security: Prod security engineer (if new telemetry or keys added)
Support: L2 contact for incident escalations
